_about: The Monk 4: Monk 3 plus Ahmed's Monk 3.1 master recipe (phantasic ff71824, 9 Oct 2026), opt-in keys only: -15 LUFS, ratio 2, threshold -18, true-peak ceiling -3.5 as postLimit (the fork's name for his `tp`). Apply with `master.py --from-json build/master.json`. His Monk has no audio fade, so none is set here (master.fadeOut is available to a reel that wants one). Leaves monk and monk-3 untouched.
